holds.reason: The three forms given by Heilprin are retained. The Tanhuma uses Botzrayi in the Yonah notice but does not identify it with either alternate form or establish a shared father.
The exact external source for this kinship remains unlocated.
Tanhuma and another Heilprin notice attest Yonah Botzrayi. Whether the name there is his father’s name remains open.
